title: Make 10 to Subtract
objective: The bridge-through-ten idea works in reverse for subtraction — break the number being subtracted so the first stop is exactly at 10.
studentQuestion: Can we get to a friendly ten on the way to the answer?
newIdea: Applying the same benchmark-bridging structure to subtraction.

teaching.see: 13 is close to 10 — subtracting down to 10 first might help.
teaching.break: 5 = 3 + 2 (split so the first 3 brings 13 down to 10).
teaching.transform: 10 - 2 = 8 — same value as 13 - 5, reached via the ten.

mastery.evidence: Correctly executes the subtraction bridge for 2 problems.
